summary: Package apps into containers and run them on the right Azure compute (ACI, Container Apps, or AKS) with ACR for image management.
highYield: ACR: repositories, image pull secrets, ACR Tasks (cloud build/push), geo-replication, admin user vs service principal/Entra auth.
Choose: ACI (single quick container) vs Container Apps (serverless scale, KEDA/Dapr) vs AKS (full orchestration).
AKS: node pools, scaling (cluster autoscaler, HPA, KEDA), networking (kubenet vs Azure CNI), persistent volumes.
Container Apps: revisions, ingress, HTTP/KEDA scale rules, Dapr integration.
Docker: multi-stage builds, layer caching, ENTRYPOINT vs CMD, HEALTHCHECK + liveness/readiness probes.
memoryAids: ACI = single, ACA = serverless, AKS = full control.
ACR Tasks = build/push in the cloud, no local Docker.

domain: Develop AI solutions by using Azure data management services
summary: Feed AI workloads with the right data stores and retrieval (vector/search) services for RAG and model data.
highYield: Azure SQL DB (serverless, DTU/vCore, geo-replication) vs Cosmos DB (request units, partition keys, consistency) for app data.
Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace) for large datasets, model artifacts, and training data.
Azure AI Search: indexes, indexers, semantic ranker, vector search, and hybrid (keyword + vector) retrieval for RAG.
Vector databases: Cosmos DB / PostgreSQL with pgvector for embeddings and similarity search.
Data ingestion/pipelines: Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or Fabric to prepare and move data.
memoryAids: Partition key = even distribution + efficient queries.
RAG = Retrieve (AI Search vectors) + Augment + Generate.
Vector search = similarity; hybrid = keyword + vector.

domain: Connect to and consume Azure services
summary: Consume Azure services via SDKs, REST, managed identities, and messaging/event services using proper authentication.
highYield: Auth: Managed Identity (system vs user assigned) vs service principal vs connection strings/keys; prefer managed identity.
Azure SDKs (.NET/Python/Java/JS) and REST with Bearer tokens via DefaultAzureCredential.
Azure AI Services: Azure OpenAI, Speech, Vision, Language; endpoint + key vs Microsoft Entra ID auth.
Messaging: Service Bus (queues/topics, FIFO via sessions) vs Event Grid (discrete events) vs Event Hubs (high-throughput streams).
Azure Functions bindings + Durable Functions for orchestration; App Service Easy Auth and MSAL for user auth.
memoryAids: Service Bus = messages (FIFO); Event Grid = discrete events; Event Hubs = streams.
DefaultAzureCredential = tries many auth methods in order.
Use managed identity - never keys in code.

domain: Secure, monitor, and troubleshoot Azure solutions
summary: Secure apps with identity and Key Vault, then observe and troubleshoot with Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
highYield: App Service authentication (Easy Auth) vs custom MSAL; Key Vault secrets with managed identity.
Application Insights: telemetry, distributed tracing, dependency calls, exceptions, live metrics, sampling.
Logging: structured logs, KQL queries, Log Analytics workspaces, diagnostic settings.
Troubleshooting: App Service diagnostics, deployment slots (staging swap/rollback), retry policies, remote debugging.
Secure networking: private endpoints, NSGs, WAF, TLS/HTTPS, CORS, secret rotation.
memoryAids: App Insights = see inside your app (traces, dependencies, exceptions).
KQL to query everything in Log Analytics.
